name: merkle-verify
description: Browser-native blockchain verification toolkit: Merkle inclusion proofs and ECDSA signature recovery, cross-checked against on-chain Solidity.
author: Kashyap Patel

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/core && npm run build --workspace=apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=packages/core && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=packages/core && npm run test --workspace=packages/contracts
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
